title: Installing Docker
definition: The process of setting up the Docker environment on a host operating system, which differs significantly between Linux, Windows, and macOS.
simpleExplanation: Downloading the Docker engine so your computer understands how to run containers.
realWorldExample: On Linux, you run a few `apt-get` commands in the terminal to install the raw Engine. On Mac and Windows, you usually download a graphical app called 'Docker Desktop'.

basic: Do you install the exact same Docker software file on Linux as you do on a Macbook?
intermediate: Why does installing Docker on Windows require WSL2 (Windows Subsystem for Linux)?

answers.question: Same software file?
answers.answer: No. The installation architectures are vastly different.

answers.question: Why WSL2?
answers.answer: Because Docker containers rely on core features of the Linux Kernel (like namespaces and cgroups). Windows does not have a Linux Kernel. WSL2 runs a highly efficient, invisible Linux kernel inside Windows, allowing Docker to run natively.
